SM_SP_StarLily_01.description: Three notched jade pads surrounding a silver-white, three-tier pointed star lily with warm gold stamens.

SM_SP_StarLily_02.description: Asymmetric silver-white lily with three different pads and a closed side bud.

SM_SP_StarFlowers.description: Blue-silver curved grass blades supporting four five-point pale blue star flowers with gold centres.

SM_SP_OldWillow.description: Asymmetric old willow with sinuous fluted trunk, six branching green leaf crowns and open, jade drooping leaf trails.
